question: What is the meaning of environmental cost indicators demolition/disposal/processing phase c in relation to sustainability, environmental cost indicators?
data_point: environmental cost indicators demolition/disposal/processing phase c
description: The meaning of environmental cost indicators demolition/disposal/processing phase c in relation to sustainability, environmental cost indicators is that they focus on evaluating the environmental impact and costs associated with the demolition, disposal, and processing of building materials during the end-of-life phase. These indicators help assess the sustainability of building systems by considering the environmental consequences of dismantling and managing building components at the end of their lifecycle.
